heading: Pathian Tel Kumpipa

paite: Leitung a kumpipate akisa duamduam ua, heutute'n leng TOUPA leh athaunilh kalh asawm chiat uh,
agaknate uh hihtat in, akhauhualte uh ei a kipan i paimang ding uh," chi in.
"Van a tupa anui dia; TOUPA'N amaute anuihsan ding hi.
Huai khit chiang in heh in akiang uah thu agen ding a, thangpaitak in amaute ahihmangbangta ding hi.
Kei mahmah in ka mual siangthou Zion ah ka kumpipa ka tusak hi," achi hi.
Thusehsa ka gen ding hi; TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a; tuni in ka hon neikhia ahi.
Hon ngen in, huchi in na gouluah ding in namte ka hon pe dia, kawlmong tawp tan in na gou ding in leng ka hon pe ding hi.
Sikchiang in amaute na hihkham dia; belvelmi'n bel apaihkhap bang un na paikham ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipate aw, pilta unla; leitung a vaihawmte aw, thuzoh in omta un.
Laudan siam in TOUPA nna sem unla, ling kawm in kipak un.
Tapa tawp unla, huchi keileh aheh ding a, lam lak ah na mangthang kha ding uh, athangpai zok ding hi. Amah a ginna koih tengteng ahampha uhi.
